usb4_capacitor_research.status: User accepted existing Murata X5R EIA 0201 capacitors for the first prototype on 2026-10-14. RX GRM033R61E334KE15D / C723889 remains selected at 330 nF, 25 V, +/-10%. USB4 capacitance and channel compliance remain unverified. No screening or circuit substitution.

requirements.tolerance_notes: ASMedia documents examined do not state capacitor tolerance. +/-5% is an RX selection target to improve margin over +/-10%, not an ASMedia requirement. Temperature, DC bias, aging, ESD stress and channel loss still require qualification.

usb_if_2019_design_presentation_page_49.package: Consider 0201 for lower parasitics and better return loss than 0402.

usb4_normative_reference.note: Verified directly in the November 2025 normative specification, not only the 2019 presentation.

RX_selection_priority.user_preference: Retain EIA 0201 and >=25 V. User accepts the existing +/-10% Murata RX part for the first prototype, including the initial lower-limit margin concern.
RX_selection_priority.engineering_selection_target: Earlier +/-5% target is superseded for this prototype. Selected part is GRM033R61E334KE15D, 330 nF, 25 V, +/-10%, X5R, EIA 0201.
RX_selection_priority.assessment: Accepted prototype choice. Its 297-363 nF initial interval does not guarantee the USB4 300-363 nF requirement. Temperature, DC bias and aging add uncertainty. No production qualification is implied.
RX_selection_priority.cold_temperature_priority: Secondary; user accepts a weaker limit.

USB-IF design presentation, November 20, 2019. PDF page 49 compares 0201 and 0402 capacitor footprints and recommends considering 0201 for lower parasitics and better return loss. The example does not establish performance for this board. Connector-facing TX capacitors: 135-265 nF, 25 V; RX: 300-363 nF, 25 V.

sources.finding: High-dielectric MLCC capacitance decreases with aging. Heating during soldering can restore capacitance and restart aging.
Part rating, test voltage/frequency, specified thermal preparation, and measurement cautions. Soldering-heat change allowances do not guarantee retention of a selected +/-5% band.

prototype_decision.status: User accepted retaining the existing capacitors for the first prototype.
prototype_decision.qualification_status: Unverified; prototype acceptance does not establish compliance.

usb_interface_review.scope: USB2, CC, SBU, VBUS, integrated attach/orientation and fixed-5 V sink support; current TVS details.
usb_interface_review.integrated_functions: Datasheet documents built-in 5.1 kohm Rd on each CC pin, orientation detection and BMC PHY for fixed-5 V UFP/sink operation. No duplicate external Rd or separate controller needed for those documented functions.
usb_interface_review.VBUS_followup: G1 is explicitly 5 V tolerant. No mandatory divider/filter requirement was established for integrated fixed-5 V UFP/sink operation. Retain the existing direct connection as the working prototype circuit; the selectable reference network alone is not a blocker to other schematic work. The examined datasheet does not explicitly establish powered-off VBUS tolerance; assess VBUS present with ATX/VCCH absent during power design. A divider alone does not resolve powered-off tolerance or provide overvoltage protection.

TVS_coverage.placement: One per conductor to ground on bridge side of AC coupling capacitor.
TVS_coverage.other_USB_signals: No external TVS on USB2, CC, SBU or VBUS. Reference sheet 3 also omits separate clamps there; absence alone does not establish functional wiring error. System protection remains unqualified.

validation.additional_checks: Compiled-netlist mapping, isolation and shell-ground checks passed.
validation.hardware_validation: Not performed. Firmware configuration, powered-off attach, negotiation and protection performance remain unverified.

VBUS_recommendation.status: Engineering recommendation; no additional divider/filter justified by the evidence reviewed.
VBUS_recommendation.scope: Normal fixed-5 V VBUS with powered bridge; no claim of powered-off or system-level transient qualification.

psu_control_review.behavior: Dedicated PSU starts whenever AC is present and its rear switch is on. R_PSU_ON can be removed to release PS_ON#. White PSU OK LED follows PWR_OK. USB presence does not control the PSU.

reference.notes: Intel document 336521-002. Sections 3.3.1/3.3.3 and tables 3-9/3-10 define PWR_OK and PS_ON#; table 4-1 maps pins 8/9/16.
